blocks.html: Frequently Ask Questions

What is the 3C Vitamin Glow Facial?

The 3C Vitamin Glow Facial is a luxurious skincare treatment that combines three advanced forms of Vitamin C to brighten, rejuvenate, and revitalize your skin. It’s designed to target oily, acne-prone, and dull skin, leaving you with a radiant, glowing complexion.

Who is this facial best for?

This facial is perfect for:

  • Oily and acne-prone skin (not for active acne).
  • Dull or uneven skin tone.
  • Anyone seeking brightening, rejuvenation, and a healthy glow.
Who should avoid this facial?

This treatment is not recommended for:

  • Those with compromised or thin skin barriers.
  • Skin with open wounds, broken skin, or steroid dependency.
  • Individuals with sensitive skin prone to tingling (mild tingling may occur but is normal).
What makes the 3C Vitamin Glow Facial unique?

This facial stands out because it uses freshly activated, mono-dose Vitamin C for maximum potency and effectiveness. It also combines three powerful forms of Vitamin C (AA2, SAP, and EAA) to brighten, fight aging, and protect against pollution, along with gentle exfoliation and an oxygenating mask for a radiant finish.

What does the treatment process involve?

The treatment includes:

  1. Deep cleansing
  2. Gentle exfoliation with Pronalen AHA 50 to remove dead skin cells.
  3. Booster Application – three advanced forms of Vitamin C for brightening and rejuvenation freshly activated.
  4. Detox Massage
  5. Oxygenating Mask
  6. Hydration with booster
  7. Special after care with Vitamin C Radiance Cream
Is the exfoliation step harsh on the skin?

Not at all! The exfoliation uses Pronalen AHA 50, a gentle yet effective blend of AHAs derived from natural fruits. It’s designed to be tolerable for most skin types, including sensitive skin, while delivering a refreshed, smooth complexion.

Will my skin feel irritated after the facial?

Most clients experience no irritation, though mild tingling may occur during the treatment, which is normal. The facial is formulated with soothing ingredients like Coolact to ensure a comfortable experience.

How soon will I see results?

Many clients notice an immediate glow and improved skin texture after just one session. For optimal results, we recommend a series of treatments tailored to your skin’s needs.

How often should I get the 3C Vitamin Glow Facial?

For best results, we recommend getting this facial every 4-6 weeks. This allows your skin to fully benefit from the treatment while maintaining its radiant glow.

Can I combine this facial with other treatments?

Yes, the 3C Vitamin Glow Facial can be paired with other treatments to address specific concerns. Consult with your skincare specialist to create a customized plan for your skin.

Is there any downtime after the facial?

No, there’s no downtime! You can resume your daily activities immediately after the treatment, with your skin looking refreshed and glowing.

How do I maintain the results at home?

To prolong the results, we recommend using a Vitamin C serum and following a consistent skincare routine that includes sunscreen, moisturizer, and gentle exfoliation. Your skincare specialist can recommend products tailored to your skin type.
